verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents both a full REST API (v3, with official JS/PHP/Python/Ruby libraries) and a dedicated Store API purpose-built for headless cart/checkout/product frontends, enabling a fully custom headless storefront to be built against documented, versioned endpoints. Missing for 10: no first-party official headless frontend framework/starter kit evidenced, and no independent hands-on report confirming a production headless build.
